fullPassage: The recognition of a word involves both visual-perceptual and cognitive processes. According to some researchers, skilled readers perceive almost all the letters or letter-groups in a word during a visual fixation. Becoming fluent and swift at word identification mainly involves making relevant connections between the letter strings within words and the sound units they represent. What the brain does is recognise instantly any familiar groups or patterns of letters. As a result of previous reading experience, these letter patterns have become associated with pronounceable parts of known words and the images are stored in long-term memory. Using information provided by the letter patterns, most printed words can be identified very swiftly by the skilled reader, usually within 300 milliseconds. In the case of all unfamiliar words, recognition and meaning are registered simultaneously. Any words not read before will take slightly longer to decipher but are usually identified from their pronounceable spelling patterns or by decoding them letter by letter. All words that are encountered frequently enough become stored in memory as ‘sight words’ and no longer need to be decoded.

det.korean: ③ recognising → recognise: 'What the brain does is + 동사원형' 강조구문이므로 동사원형 필요

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④ independently(독립적으로) → simultaneously(동시에): 인식과 의미가 '동시에' 등록된다는 문맥

det.tip: simultaneously(동시에) ↔ independently(독립적으로)

det.korean: ① clumsy(서투른) → fluent(유창한): 단어 식별에서 '유창하고 빠르게' 되는 것이 핵심이라는 문맥
det.analysis:
❌ ① clumsy(서투른) → fluent(유창한): Becoming _____ and swift at word identification에서 swift(빠른)와 병렬, '유창한(fluent)'이 적절. clumsy는 문맥 반대
✅ ② instantly(즉시): 뇌가 익숙한 글자 패턴을 '즉시' 인식한다는 문맥에 적절
✅ ③ decipher(해독하다): 읽어본 적 없는 단어를 '해독하는' 데 시간이 걸린다는 문맥에 적절
✅ ④ decoded(해독된): 시각 단어는 더 이상 '해독될' 필요 없다는 문맥에 적절
det.tip: fluent(유창한) ↔ clumsy(서투른, 어색한)

"숙련된 독자는 시각 고정 시 단어 내 거의 모든 글자나 글자 그룹을 인식한다."

questions.stem: 윗글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

✅ ④ 원문: 'All words that are encountered frequently enough become stored in memory as sight words' — 정확히 일치
det.tip: sight words = 시각 단어 (반복 노출로 즉시 인식 가능한 단어)

questions.passage: The recognition of a word involves both visual-perceptual and cognitive processes. According to some researchers, skilled readers perceive almost all the letters or letter-groups in a word during a visual fixation. Becoming fluent and swift at word identification mainly involves making relevant connections between the letter strings within words and the sound units they represent. What the brain does is recognise instantly any familiar groups or patterns of letters. As a result of previous reading experience, these letter patterns have become associated with pronounceable parts of known words and the images are stored in long-term memory. Using information provided by the letter patterns, most printed words can be identified very swiftly by the skilled reader, usually within 300 milliseconds. In the case of all unfamiliar words, recognition and meaning are registered simultaneously. Any words not read before will take slightly longer to decipher but are usually identified from their pronounceable spelling patterns or by decoding them letter by letter. All words that are encountered frequently enough become stored in memory as ‘sight words’ and no longer need to be decoded.
questions.stem: 윗글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① 일치: 'making relevant connections between the letter strings within words and the sound units they represent'

❌ ③ 불일치: 'recognition and meaning are registered simultaneously'에서 인식과 의미가 '동시에' 등록. '별도의 과정'은 원문과 반대
✅ ④ 일치: 'these letter patterns have become associated with pronounceable parts of known words'
det.tip: simultaneously = 동시에. 인식과 의미 파악이 분리되지 않음이 핵심

ch: 단어 식별의 유창성은 글자 문자열과 소리 단위의 연결과 관련된다.
